environment.description: Laravel 10.x application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an internal Application Load Balancer (scheme: internal). The ALB resides in private subnets (10.0.64.0/19, 10.0.96.0/19). A Network Load Balancer in front performs TLS termination and has a target group health check on /health. The NLB's security group allows inbound only from CIDR 10.200.0.0/16 (corporate VPN egress range) and 172.20.0.0/14 (peered monitoring VPC). AWS PrivateLink is NOT used; instead, VPC peering with route table entries ensures only the two specified CIDR blocks can route to the NLB's ENIs. Additionally, the VPC's Network ACL on the ALB subnets has explicit DENY rules for all source IPs outside 10.200.0.0/16 and 172.20.0.0/14 on ports 80 and 443. APP_DEBUG=false. No public DNS record exists for the service; internal Route53 private hosted zone resolves doc-processor.internal.corp.

config.vpc_nacl_deny: all sources outside 10.200.0.0/16 and 172.20.0.0/14 on ports 80,443
config.dns: private hosted zone only, no public record
